placements.role: Designs and fabricates switchgear and bus systems for utility and data-center power distribution.

role_evidence.claim: Powell's 2025 Form 10-K lists distribution switchgear, medium-voltage breakers and bus duct among its products and identifies data centers among the customers for its commercial and industrial market.

business_summary: Powell Industries, Inc. is a Houston-based, Nasdaq-listed manufacturer of custom-engineered switchgear, medium-voltage circuit breakers, bus duct and integrated power control rooms. Its historical core markets are oil and gas, petrochemical and LNG; utility and commercial work, including data centres, is the newer leg. It is by far the smallest issuer in this batch by market capitalisation and the only one whose fiscal year ends in September.

exposure_summary.narrative: Powell has one placement, on power-equipment, the chain's money corner and its most UNDISCOVERED link. That single placement is the cleanest exposure in the batch: it is a switchgear manufacturer and nothing else, so the link's demand and the company's revenue are close to the same variable. Its own fiscal third-quarter 2026 release names a single data-centre order above four hundred million dollars, which is a disclosed, dated, order-level attribution rather than a thematic claim.

disclosed_revenue_exposure.basis: No data-centre revenue percentage is disclosed. The fiscal third-quarter 2026 release (accession 0000080420-26-000103) discloses one named data-centre mega order and a total backlog figure, but does not break revenue out by end market.

market_cap.source_name: Session-computed 2026-09-04, correcting a pre-split share-count defect in data/market/POWL.json quality.derived.market_cap: diluted weighted-average shares 36604000 (Powell Industries Q3 FY2026 8-K exhibit, accession 0000080420-26-000103, quarter ended 2026-06-30) multiplied by the close 182.71 (data/market/POWL.json, price_status AGREED, as of 2026-08-28)
market_cap.basis: The prior value 2205342222.38 used data/market/POWL.json quality.shares_used 12070178 as_of 2025-09-30, the PRE-split share count. Powell effected a three-for-one forward stock split effective 2026-04-02 (record date 2026-03-20), verbatim in the fetched 8-K: 'Each shareholder of record as of the close of trading on March 20, 2026 ... received ... two additional shares for every one share held ... Trading began on a split-adjusted basis at market open on April 6, 2026.' The market file's shares_used was never rolled forward past the split while price 182.71 already trades split-adjusted, so market_cap was understated roughly 3x. This corrected figure uses the split-adjusted diluted share count the 8-K itself reports for the quarter ended 2026-06-30 ('Weighted average shares ... Diluted 36,604'), verbatim-verified in data/edgar/docs/POWL.json. REQ-20260904-40/41/42 are PENDING to have the Actions venue recompute data/market/POWL.json quality.derived and quality.shares_used from a corrected post-split share count; this session-computed figure should be replaced by that recompute once it lands, per the venue rule (Sieve does not fetch market data, but combines two already-fetched, dated, sourced figures the same way this profile already computes operating_margin and cash_conversion from companyfacts inputs).

ev_to_sales.basis: Corrected enterprise value 6054355840.0 = corrected market_cap 6687916840.0 minus cash 633561000 (data/market/POWL.json fundamentals.cash, as of 2026-06-30) plus debt 0 (data/market/POWL.json fundamentals.total_debt, the same stale 2022-09-30 zero observation already named NULL-basis under leverage.net_debt_to_ebitda; carried forward unchanged, same convention the original enterprise_value used), divided by revenue 1104318000. crowdedness_caveats: This is the least covered name in the batch and the one where the un-crowded claim survives contact with the data: data/market/POWL.json pcs records 4 analysts as of 2026-08-29 against 25 for Eaton and 33 for GE Vernova.

Institutional ownership is nonetheless 93.5% and short interest 10.2% of float in the same pcs block, so thin sell-side coverage is not the same as an unowned or uncontested stock; the short interest is the highest in this batch by a wide margin.
Axis-A is COVERAGE-THIN at 100.0 rather than DARK, which is the honest reading: the retail-attention measurement is thin rather than confidently quiet, and the pcs gate state is ADVISORY.
The 52-week range in data/market/POWL.json runs 85.7167 to 322.05, a spread that makes any single-date crowdedness reading fragile.

data/market/POWL.json insider records 89 Form 4 transactions in the trailing year to 2026-09-02: 69 open-market sales totaling roughly $68.4 million in value against 18 distinct insiders and only 1 non-derivative purchase (a $0.01 exercise-and-sell, not an open-market buy). Heavy, broad insider selling into a name this thinly covered is itself a crowdedness signal, distinct from the short interest already noted.

confidence_audit.basis: Counts cover the canonical metric fields only. VERIFIED is a figure read directly off SEC companyfacts as reported. INFERRED is a figure computed from SEC companyfacts, with the derivation named in its basis; where a market price enters the computation the basis says so explicitly, because the price leg is the repo's own dual-source market plane (data/market/POWL.json, price_status AGREED) and not an issuer document. Updated 2026-09-04: valuation.market_cap, price_to_sales, price_to_earnings and ev_to_sales moved from a market-file-derived read to a session-computed INFERRED figure correcting a pre-split share-count defect (see data_gaps); reverse_dcf.implied_fcf_cagr and horizon_spread moved from SPECULATIVE to NULL, retracted rather than hand-resolved, pending an Actions recompute over the corrected enterprise value. NULL is a field looked for and not found, or in this case a figure known to be wrong and not yet correctly refetched, never estimated.
